programme.notes: All six answers come from the 2027-admission page. The readable text splits some '2027' as '202 7' (markup); quotes copy that.

english.quote: 2.1 TOEFL iBT – exams taken before January 21, 2026: minimum 90 (0 – 120 scale); exams taken on or after January 21, 2026: minimum 4.5 (1 – 6 scale). Request scores using GC's institution code 6210 via ETS. 2.2 IELTS: 6 or above 2.3 Duolingo English Test : 120 or above
english.notes: For non-native speakers of English. TOEFL 90 on the 0-120 scale (tests before 2026-01-21) or 4.5 on the new 1-6 scale. No per-section minimums published. Exemptions: SAT EBRW >= 650, ACT Reading and English >= 27, or 4 years of study in listed English-speaking countries.

value.description: No school GPA threshold. Thresholds are on tests: CSCA (with Mathematics) required; A-Level Mathematics A or above; IB Mathematics HL 5 or SL 7; SAT/ACT middle-50% of the 2026 admitted class (SAT 1390-1500) is indicative, not a minimum.

gpa.quote: If you apply with A-Level scores, you must have Mathematics A or above.
gpa.notes: Test/subject thresholds only; 'The admission decision will be based on a comprehensive evaluation.'

deadline.quote: Application Deadlines for 2027 Admission Early Action: November 1 , 2026 (Beijing Time, GMT+8) Regular Application: March 31, 202 7 (Beijing Time, GMT+8)
deadline.notes: Regular Application deadline for 2027 admission, Beijing Time (GMT+8); Early Action 2026-11-01. The page prints the regular year as '202 7' (markup split); '2027' appears in the heading of the same quote. CSCA scores due by 2027-06-30 after pre-admission.

value.population: international students, Engineering Cluster Program in English

tuition.notes: 'Tuition rates are subject to the record-filing with the governing authorities'; 'The fees above are estimates and are subject to change.' Application fee USD 75; insurance RMB 800/academic year.

scholarship_exists.quote: Excellent applicants will have the opportunity to be awarded different kinds of scholarships, such as the Chinese Government Scholarship, Shanghai Government Scholarship, SJTU Scholarship, and others.
scholarship_exists.notes: First-Class: tuition waiver + living allowance 2,500 RMB/month + accommodation subsidy 1,100 RMB/month + insurance (4 years); Second-Class: 50% tuition waiver + accommodation subsidy + insurance; Third-Class: 25% tuition waiver + insurance. Competitive; results with admission; not combinable with other scholarships.

scholarship_international.quote: Students applying for Shanghai Government Scholarship and SJTU Scholarship can click the option "Apply for scholarship" when completing SJTU's online application form.
scholarship_international.notes: The page is the international-student admission page (applicants must be non-Chinese citizens); the SJTU Scholarship is applied for in the same application.
